# list, map and color methods are bodyless #[intrinsic] declarations, so each
# backend needs an emitter for every one. Go had none for indexOf/reverse/
# slice/hex, and its filter/map/keys/values/get emitted []any — which does not
# assign to a []int, so the generated program did not compile. The go case
# therefore builds with the real toolchain rather than grepping.

sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html --out=outjs app.sngl
grep 'indexOf\(2\)' outjs/index.html
grep '\.reverse\(\)' outjs/index.html
grep '\.size' outjs/index.html
grep 'padStart' outjs/index.html

sngl generate --lang=kotlin --platform=android --opt=main=true --out=outkt app.sngl
grep '\.indexOf\(2\)' outkt/app/src/main/java/test/sngl/app/MainScreen.kt
grep '\.reversed\(\)' outkt/app/src/main/java/test/sngl/app/MainScreen.kt
grep '\.filter\(' outkt/app/src/main/java/test/sngl/app/MainScreen.kt
grep '\.getOrDefault\(' outkt/app/src/main/java/test/sngl/app/MainScreen.kt

[!exec:go] skip 'go toolchain required'
sngl build --lang=go --platform=bubbletea --opt name=lm bt.sngl
exists lm

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

component main node {
    var xs list<int> = [3, 1, 2]
    var m map<string, int> = {"a" = 1}

    var idx int = xs.indexOf(2)
    var rev list<int> = xs.reverse()
    var sl list<int> = xs.slice(0, 2)
    var ev list<int> = xs.filter(func(x int) => x > 1)
    var ss list<string> = xs.map(func(x int) => string(x))
    var n int = m.length()
    var ks list<string> = m.keys()
    var vs list<int> = m.values()
    var has bool = m.contains("a")
    var got int = m.get("a", 0)
    var c color = #ff0000
    var hx string = c.hex()

    text(value=string(idx) + string(rev.length()) + string(sl.length()) + string(ev.length()) + ss.join(",") + string(n) + string(ks.length()) + string(vs.length()) + string(has) + string(got) + hx)
}

window {
    main
}
-- bt.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

output { go { bubbletea } }

component main node {
    var xs list<int> = [3, 1, 2]
    var m map<string, int> = {"a" = 1}

    var idx int = xs.indexOf(2)
    var rev list<int> = xs.reverse()
    var sl list<int> = xs.slice(0, 2)
    var ev list<int> = xs.filter(func(x int) => x > 1)
    var ss list<string> = xs.map(func(x int) => string(x))
    var n int = m.length()
    var ks list<string> = m.keys()
    var vs list<int> = m.values()
    var has bool = m.contains("a")
    var got int = m.get("a", 0)
    var c color = #ff0000
    var hx string = c.hex()

    text(value=string(idx) + string(rev.length()) + string(sl.length()) + string(ev.length()) + ss.join(",") + string(n) + string(ks.length()) + string(vs.length()) + string(has) + string(got) + hx)
}

window {
    main
}
